The '''Library Wing''' of [[Northshire Abbey]], located in [[Northshire Valley]] in [[Elwynn Forest]], is home to the [[priest]] trainer [[Priestess Anetta]] and the [[mage]] trainer [[Khelden Bremen]] for the least experienced of the [[Stormwind Army]]'s [[Adventurer|recruits]]. It is situated south of the [[Main Hall (Northshire)|Main Hall]], and the [[Hall of Arms (Northshire)|Hall of Arms]] lies on the opposite side of the abbey.
